What holds it together

Three decisions, everything else follows

Local-first

The core runs offline. Cloud services are opt-in connectors, switchable off at any time.

Contract-driven

One written app contract, ten applications built to it. Answer it and the dashboard picks the app up by itself.

Honest by law

An unmeasured value is reported as unmeasured, never as a zero. The same rule governs this website.

All three in full, trade-offs included →

The shape of it

A headless core, nine applications around it

Every application owns its port, its database and its user interface. The core orchestrates and relays — it never writes outward on its own.

Each one runs alone. One contract joins them.

The method

Laws before code

Law · human gates

“Nothing irreversible without a human. Money, publishing and deletion sit behind explicit gates. The trading fleet proposes; a person decides.”

Repository README, Principles↗Source: the Principles section of the repository README

  1. The assistants propose

    They observe and suggest. Nothing has an effect yet.

  2. A person decides

    A different endpoint, a fresh authentication, an audit entry the proposing side cannot edit.

  3. Only then, it takes effect

    Money, publishing and deletion — the three that are never reversible.
